versos.hebraico: וְזֹ֣את הַבְּרָכָ֗ה אֲשֶׁ֨ר בֵּרַ֥ךְ מֹשֶׁ֛ה אִ֥ישׁ הָאֱלֹהִ֖ים אֶת־בְּנֵ֣י יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל לִפְנֵ֖י מוֹתֽוֹ׃

controles.web: This is the blessing with which Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
controles.kjv: And this is the blessing, wherewith Moses the man of God blessed the children of Israel before his death.
controles.livre: E esta é a bênção com a qual abençoou Moisés homem de Deus aos filhos de Israel, antes que morresse.

versos.hebraico: וַיֹּאמַ֗ר יְהוָ֞ה מִסִּינַ֥י בָּא֙ וְזָרַ֤ח מִשֵּׂעִיר֙ לָ֔מוֹ הוֹפִ֨יעַ֙ מֵהַ֣ר פָּארָ֔ן וְאָתָ֖ה מֵרִבְבֹ֣ת קֹ֑דֶשׁ מִֽימִינ֕וֹ אשדת לָֽמוֹ׃

controles.web: He said,  “Yahweh came from Sinai, and rose from Seir to them. He shone from Mount Paran. He came from the ten thousands of holy ones. At his right hand was a fiery law for them.
controles.kjv: And he said, The Lord came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them.
controles.livre: E disse: O SENHOR veio de Sinai, E de Seir lhes iluminou; Resplandeceu do monte de Parã, E veio com dez mil santos: À sua direita a lei de fogo para eles.

versos.hebraico: אַ֚ף חֹבֵ֣ב עַמִּ֔ים כָּל־קְדֹשָׁ֖יו בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְהֵם֙ תֻּכּ֣וּ לְרַגְלֶ֔ךָ יִשָּׂ֖א מִדַּבְּרֹתֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: Yes, he loves the people. All his saints are in your hand. They sat down at your feet. Each receives your words.
controles.kjv: Yea, he loved the people; all his saints are in thy hand: and they sat down at thy feet; every one shall receive of thy words.
controles.livre: Ainda amou os povos; Todos seus santos em tua mão: Eles também se chegaram a teus pés: Receberam de teus ditos.

versos.hebraico: תּוֹרָ֥ה צִוָּה־לָ֖נוּ מֹשֶׁ֑ה מוֹרָשָׁ֖ה קְהִלַּ֥ת יַעֲקֹֽב׃

controles.web: Moses commanded us a law, an inheritance for the assembly of Jacob.
controles.kjv: Moses commanded us a law, even the inheritance of the congregation of Jacob.
controles.livre: Lei nos mandou Moisés, Herança à congregação de Jacó.

versos.hebraico: וַיְהִ֥י בִישֻׁר֖וּן מֶ֑לֶךְ בְּהִתְאַסֵּף֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם יַ֖חַד שִׁבְטֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃

controles.web: He was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people were gathered, all the tribes of Israel together.
controles.kjv: And he was king in Jeshurun, when the heads of the people and the tribes of Israel were gathered together.
controles.livre: E foi rei em Jesurum, Quando se congregaram os chefes do povo Com as tribos de Israel.

versos.hebraico: יְחִ֥י רְאוּבֵ֖ן וְאַל־יָמֹ֑ת וִיהִ֥י מְתָ֖יו מִסְפָּֽר׃ס

controles.web: “Let Reuben live, and not die; Nor let his men be few.”
controles.kjv: Let Reuben live, and not die; and let not his men be few.
controles.livre: Viva Rúben, e não morra; E sejam seus homens em número.

versos.hebraico: וְזֹ֣את לִֽיהוּדָה֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ שְׁמַ֤ע יְהוָה֙ ק֣וֹל יְהוּדָ֔ה וְאֶל־עַמּ֖וֹ תְּבִיאֶ֑נּוּ יָדָיו֙ רָ֣ב ל֔וֹ וְעֵ֥זֶר מִצָּרָ֖יו תִּהְיֶֽה׃ס

controles.web: This is for Judah. He said,  “Hear, Yahweh, the voice of Judah. Bring him in to his people. With his hands he contended for himself. You shall be a help against his adversaries.”
controles.kjv: And this is the blessing of Judah: and he said, Hear, Lord, the voice of Judah, and bring him unto his people: let his hands be sufficient for him; and be thou an help to him from his enemies.
controles.livre: E esta bênção para Judá. Disse assim: Ouve, ó SENHOR, a voz de Judá, E leva-o a seu povo; suas mãos lhe bastem, E tu sejas ajuda contra seus inimigos.

versos.hebraico: וּלְלֵוִ֣י אָמַ֔ר תֻּמֶּ֥יךָ וְאוּרֶ֖יךָ לְאִ֣ישׁ חֲסִידֶ֑ךָ אֲשֶׁ֤ר נִסִּיתוֹ֙ בְּמַסָּ֔ה תְּרִיבֵ֖הוּ עַל־מֵ֥י מְרִיבָֽה׃

controles.web: About Levi he said,  “Your Thummim and your Urim are with your godly one, whom you proved at Massah, with whom you contended at the waters of Meribah.
controles.kjv: And of Levi he said, Let thy Thummim and thy Urim be with thy holy one, whom thou didst prove at Massah, and with whom thou didst strive at the waters of Meribah;
controles.livre: E a Levi disse: Teu Tumim e teu Urim, com teu bom homem Ao qual tentaste em Massá, E lhe fizeste brigar nas águas da briga;

versos.hebraico: הָאֹמֵ֞ר לְאָבִ֤יו וּלְאִמּוֹ֙ לֹ֣א רְאִיתִ֔יו וְאֶת־אֶחָיו֙ לֹ֣א הִכִּ֔יר וְאֶת־בנו לֹ֣א יָדָ֑ע כִּ֤י שָֽׁמְרוּ֙ אִמְרָתֶ֔ךָ וּבְרִֽיתְךָ֖ יִנְצֹֽרוּ׃

controles.web: He said of his father, and of his mother, ‘I have not seen him.’ He didn’t acknowledge his brothers, nor did he know his own children; for they have observed your word, and keep your covenant.
controles.kjv: Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him; neither did he acknowledge his brethren, nor knew his own children: for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant.
controles.livre: O que disse a seu pai e a sua mãe: Nunca os vi: nem conheceu a seus irmãos, nem conheceu a seus filhos: Pelo qual eles guardarão tuas palavras, E observarão teu pacto.

versos.hebraico: יוֹר֤וּ מִשְׁפָּטֶ֨יךָ֙ לְיַעֲקֹ֔ב וְתוֹרָתְךָ֖ לְיִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל יָשִׂ֤ימוּ קְטוֹרָה֙ בְּאַפֶּ֔ךָ וְכָלִ֖יל עַֽל־מִזְבְּחֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: They shall teach Jacob your ordinances, and Israel your law. They shall put incense before you, and whole burnt offering on your altar.
controles.kjv: They shall teach Jacob thy judgments, and Israel thy law: they shall put incense before thee, and whole burnt sacrifice upon thine altar.
controles.livre: Eles ensinarão teus juízos a Jacó, E tua lei a Israel; Porão o incenso diante de ti, E o holocausto sobre teu altar.

versos.hebraico: בָּרֵ֤ךְ יְהוָה֙ חֵיל֔וֹ וּפֹ֥עַל יָדָ֖יו תִּרְצֶ֑ה מְחַ֨ץ מָתְנַ֧יִם קָמָ֛יו וּמְשַׂנְאָ֖יו מִן־יְקוּמֽוּן׃ס

controles.web: Yahweh, bless his skills. Accept the work of his hands. Strike through the hips of those who rise up against him, of those who hate him, that they not rise again.”
controles.kjv: Bless, Lord, his substance, and accept the work of his hands: smite through the loins of them that rise against him, and of them that hate him, that they rise not again.
controles.livre: Abençoa, ó SENHOR, o que fizerem, E recebe com agrado a obra de suas mãos: Fere os lombos de seus inimigos, E dos que lhe odiarem; para que nunca se levantem.

versos.hebraico: לְבִנְיָמִ֣ן אָמַ֔ר יְדִ֣יד יְהֹוָ֔ה יִשְׁכֹּ֥ן לָבֶ֖טַח עָלָ֑יו חֹפֵ֤ף עָלָיו֙ כָּל־הַיּ֔וֹם וּבֵ֥ין כְּתֵיפָ֖יו שָׁכֵֽן׃ס

controles.web: About Benjamin he said,  “The beloved of Yahweh will dwell in safety by him. He covers him all day long. He dwells between his shoulders.”
controles.kjv: And of Benjamin he said, The beloved of the Lord shall dwell in safety by him; and the Lord shall cover him all the day long, and he shall dwell between his shoulders.
controles.livre: E a Benjamim disse: O amado do SENHOR habitará confiante próximo dele: Ele o cobrirá sempre, E entre seus ombros morará.

versos.hebraico: וּלְיוֹסֵ֣ף אָמַ֔ר מְבֹרֶ֥כֶת יְהֹוָ֖ה אַרְצ֑וֹ מִמֶּ֤גֶד שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ מִטָּ֔ל וּמִתְּה֖וֹם רֹבֶ֥צֶת תָּֽחַת׃

controles.web: About Joseph he said,  “His land is blessed by Yahweh, for the precious things of the heavens, for the dew, for the deep that couches beneath,
controles.kjv: And of Joseph he said, Blessed of the Lord be his land, for the precious things of heaven, for the dew, and for the deep that coucheth beneath,
controles.livre: E a José disse: Bendita do SENHOR sua terra, Pelas dádivas dos céus, pelo orvalho, E pelo abismo que abaixo jaz,

versos.hebraico: וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד תְּבוּאֹ֣ת שָׁ֑מֶשׁ וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד גֶּ֥רֶשׁ יְרָחִֽים׃

controles.web: for the precious things of the fruits of the sun, for the precious things that the moon can yield,
controles.kjv: And for the precious fruits brought forth by the sun, and for the precious things put forth by the moon,
controles.livre: E pelos excelentes frutos do sol, E pelos excelentes produtos das influências das luas,

versos.hebraico: וּמֵרֹ֖אשׁ הַרְרֵי־קֶ֑דֶם וּמִמֶּ֖גֶד גִּבְע֥וֹת עוֹלָֽם׃

controles.web: for the best things of the ancient mountains, for the precious things of the everlasting hills,
controles.kjv: And for the chief things of the ancient mountains, and for the precious things of the lasting hills,
controles.livre: E pelo cume dos montes antigos, E pelos excelentes produtos das colinas eternas,

versos.hebraico: וּמִמֶּ֗גֶד אֶ֚רֶץ וּמְלֹאָ֔הּ וּרְצ֥וֹן שֹׁכְנִ֖י סְנֶ֑ה תָּב֨וֹאתָה֙ לְרֹ֣אשׁ יוֹסֵ֔ף וּלְקָדְקֹ֖ד נְזִ֥יר אֶחָֽיו׃

controles.web: for the precious things of the earth and its fullness, the good will of him who lived in the bush. Let this come on the head of Joseph, on the crown of the head of him who was separated from his brothers.
controles.kjv: And for the precious things of the earth and fulness thereof, and for the good will of him that dwelt in the bush: let the blessing come upon the head of Joseph, and upon the top of the head of him that was separated from his brethren.
controles.livre: E pelos excelentes produtos da terra e sua plenitude; E a graça do que habitou na sarça Venha sobre a cabeça de José, E sobre ao topo da cabeça do separado de seus irmãos.

versos.hebraico: בְּכ֨וֹר שׁוֹר֜וֹ הָדָ֣ר ל֗וֹ וְקַרְנֵ֤י רְאֵם֙ קַרְנָ֔יו בָּהֶ֗ם עַמִּ֛ים יְנַגַּ֥ח יַחְדָּ֖ו אַפְסֵי־אָ֑רֶץ וְהֵם֙ רִבְב֣וֹת אֶפְרַ֔יִם וְהֵ֖ם אַלְפֵ֥י מְנַשֶּֽׁה׃ס

controles.web: The firstborn of his herd, majesty is his. His horns are the horns of the wild ox. With them he will push all of the peoples, to the ends of the earth. They are the ten thousands of Ephraim. They are the thousands of Manasseh.”
controles.kjv: His glory is like the firstling of his bullock, and his horns are like the horns of unicorns: with them he shall push the people together to the ends of the earth: and they are the ten thousands of Ephraim, and they are the thousands of Manasseh.
controles.livre: Ele é preeminente como o primogênito de seu touro, E suas pontas, chifres de boi selvagem: Com eles chifrará os povos juntos até os confins da terra: E estes são as dezenas de milhares milhares de Efraim, E estes os milhares de Manassés.

versos.hebraico: וְלִזְבוּלֻ֣ן אָמַ֔ר שְׂמַ֥ח זְבוּלֻ֖ן בְּצֵאתֶ֑ךָ וְיִשָּׂשכָ֖ר בְּאֹהָלֶֽיךָ׃

controles.web: About Zebulun he said,  “Rejoice, Zebulun, in your going out; and Issachar, in your tents.
controles.kjv: And of Zebulun he said, Rejoice, Zebulun, in thy going out; and, Issachar, in thy tents.
controles.livre: E a Zebulom disse: Alegra-te, Zebulom, quando saíres: E tu Issacar, em tuas tendas.

versos.hebraico: עַמִּים֙ הַר־יִקְרָ֔אוּ שָׁ֖ם יִזְבְּח֣וּ זִבְחֵי־צֶ֑דֶק כִּ֣י שֶׁ֤פַע יַמִּים֙ יִינָ֔קוּ וּשְׂפוּנֵ֖י טְמ֥וּנֵי חֽוֹל׃ס

controles.web: They will call the peoples to the mountain. There they will offer sacrifices of righteousness, for they will draw out the abundance of the seas, the hidden treasures of the sand.”
controles.kjv: They shall call the people unto the mountain; there they shall offer sacrifices of righteousness: for they shall suck of the abundance of the seas, and of treasures hid in the sand.
controles.livre: Chamarão os povos ao monte: Ali sacrificarão sacrifícios de justiça: Pelo qual chuparão a abundância dos mares, E os tesouros escondidos da areia.

versos.hebraico: וּלְגָ֣ד אָמַ֔ר בָּר֖וּךְ מַרְחִ֣יב גָּ֑ד כְּלָבִ֣יא שָׁכֵ֔ן וְטָרַ֥ף זְר֖וֹעַ אַף־קָדְקֹֽד׃

controles.web: About Gad he said,  “He who enlarges Gad is blessed. He dwells as a lioness, and tears the arm, yes, the crown of the head.
controles.kjv: And of Gad he said, Blessed be he that enlargeth Gad: he dwelleth as a lion, and teareth the arm with the crown of the head.
controles.livre: E a Gade disse: Bendito o que fez alargar a Gade: Como leão habitará, E arrebatará braço e testa.

versos.hebraico: וַיַּ֤רְא רֵאשִׁית֙ ל֔וֹ כִּי־שָׁ֛ם חֶלְקַ֥ת מְחֹקֵ֖ק סָפ֑וּן וַיֵּתֵא֙ רָ֣אשֵׁי עָ֔ם צִדְקַ֤ת יְהוָה֙ עָשָׂ֔ה וּמִשְׁפָּטָ֖יו עִם־יִשְׂרָאֵֽל׃ס

controles.web: He provided the first part for himself, for the lawgiver’s portion reserved was reserved for him. He came with the heads of the people. He executed the righteousness of Yahweh, His ordinances with Israel.”
controles.kjv: And he provided the first part for himself, because there, in a portion of the lawgiver, was he seated; and he came with the heads of the people, he executed the justice of the Lord, and his judgments with Israel.
controles.livre: E ele se proveu da parte primeira, Porque ali uma porção do legislador foi-lhe reservada, E veio na dianteira do povo; A justiça do SENHOR executará, E seus juízos com Israel.

versos.hebraico: וּלְדָ֣ן אָמַ֔ר דָּ֖ן גּ֣וּר אַרְיֵ֑ה יְזַנֵּ֖ק מִן־הַבָּשָֽׁן׃

controles.web: About Dan he said,  “Dan is a lion’s cub that leaps out of Bashan.”
controles.kjv: And of Dan he said, Dan is a lion’s whelp: he shall leap from Bashan.
controles.livre: E a Dã disse: Dã, leão jovem: Saltará desde Basã.

versos.hebraico: וּלְנַפְתָּלִ֣י אָמַ֔ר נַפְתָּלִי֙ שְׂבַ֣ע רָצ֔וֹן וּמָלֵ֖א בִּרְכַּ֣ת יְהוָ֑ה יָ֥ם וְדָר֖וֹם יְרָֽשָׁה׃ס

controles.web: About Naphtali he said,  “Naphtali, satisfied with favor, full of Yahweh’s blessing, Possess the west and the south.”
controles.kjv: And of Naphtali he said, O Naphtali, satisfied with favour, and full with the blessing of the Lord: possess thou the west and the south.
controles.livre: E a Naftali disse: Naftali, saciado de benevolência, E cheio da bênção do SENHOR, Possui o ocidente e o sul,

versos.hebraico: וּלְאָשֵׁ֣ר אָמַ֔ר בָּר֥וּךְ מִבָּנִ֖ים אָשֵׁ֑ר יְהִ֤י רְצוּי֙ אֶחָ֔יו וְטֹבֵ֥ל בַּשֶּׁ֖מֶן רַגְלֽוֹ׃

controles.web: About Asher he said,  “Asher is blessed with children. Let him be acceptable to his brothers. Let him dip his foot in oil.
controles.kjv: And of Asher he said, Let Asher be blessed with children; let him be acceptable to his brethren, and let him dip his foot in oil.
controles.livre: E a Aser disse: Bendito Aser em filhos: Agradável será a seus irmãos, E molhará em azeite seu pé.

versos.hebraico: בַּרְזֶ֥ל וּנְחֹ֖שֶׁת מִנְעָלֶ֑יךָ וּכְיָמֶ֖יךָ דָּבְאֶֽךָ׃

controles.web: Your bars will be iron and brass. As your days, so your strength will be.
controles.kjv: Thy shoes shall be iron and brass; and as thy days, so shall thy strength be.
controles.livre: Ferro e bronze teu calçado, E como teus dias tua força.

versos.hebraico: אֵ֥ין כָּאֵ֖ל יְשֻׁר֑וּן רֹכֵ֤ב שָׁמַ֨יִם֙ בְעֶזְרֶ֔ךָ וּבְגַאֲוָת֖וֹ שְׁחָקִֽים׃

controles.web: “There is no one like God, Jeshurun, who rides on the heavens for your help, in his excellency on the skies.
controles.kjv: There is none like unto the God of Jeshurun, who rideth upon the heaven in thy help, and in his excellency on the sky.
controles.livre: Não há como o Deus de Jesurum, Montado sobre os céus para tua ajuda, E sobre as nuvens com sua grandeza.

versos.hebraico: מְעֹנָה֙ אֱלֹ֣הֵי קֶ֔דֶם וּמִתַּ֖חַת זְרֹעֹ֣ת עוֹלָ֑ם וַיְגָ֧רֶשׁ מִפָּנֶ֛יךָ אוֹיֵ֖ב וַיֹּ֥אמֶר הַשְׁמֵֽד׃

controles.web: The eternal God is your dwelling place. Underneath are the everlasting arms. He thrust out the enemy from before you, and said, ‘Destroy!’
controles.kjv: The eternal God is thy refuge, and underneath are the everlasting arms: and he shall thrust out the enemy from before thee; and shall say, Destroy them.
controles.livre: O eterno Deus é teu refúgio E aqui abaixo os braços eternos; Ele expulsará de diante de ti ao inimigo, E dirá: Destrói.

versos.hebraico: וַיִּשְׁכֹּן֩ יִשְׂרָאֵ֨ל בֶּ֤טַח בָּדָד֙ עֵ֣ין יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל־אֶ֖רֶץ דָּגָ֣ן וְתִיר֑וֹשׁ אַף־שָׁמָ֖יו יַֽעַרְפוּ טָֽל׃

controles.web: Israel dwells in safety; the fountain of Jacob alone, In a land of grain and new wine. Yes, his heavens drop down dew.
controles.kjv: Israel then shall dwell in safety alone: the fountain of Jacob shall be upon a land of corn and wine; also his heavens shall drop down dew.
controles.livre: E Israel, fonte de Jacó, habitará confiante sozinho Em terra de grão e de vinho: Também seus céus destilarão orvalho.

versos.hebraico: אַשְׁרֶ֨יךָ יִשְׂרָאֵ֜ל מִ֣י כָמ֗וֹךָ עַ֚ם נוֹשַׁ֣ע בַּֽיהוָ֔ה מָגֵ֣ן עֶזְרֶ֔ךָ וַאֲשֶׁר־חֶ֖רֶב גַּאֲוָתֶ֑ךָ וְיִכָּֽחֲשׁ֤וּ אֹיְבֶ֨יךָ֙ לָ֔ךְ וְאַתָּ֖ה עַל־בָּמוֹתֵ֥ימוֹ תִדְרֹֽךְ׃ס

controles.web: You are happy, Israel! Who is like you, a people saved by Yahweh, the shield of your help, the sword of your excellency? Your enemies will submit themselves to you. You will tread on their high places.”
controles.kjv: Happy art thou, O Israel: who is like unto thee, O people saved by the Lord, the shield of thy help, and who is the sword of thy excellency! and thine enemies shall be found liars unto thee; and thou shalt tread upon their high places.
controles.livre: Bem-aventurado tu, ó Israel, Quem como tu, Povo salvo pelo SENHOR, Escudo de teu socorro, E espada de tua excelência? Assim teus inimigos serão humilhados, E tu pisarás sobre suas alturas.
